entry_points.text: Daemon sysfs group exposes defrag mode, three per-class maxima, pages per scan, two read-only counters and two sleep intervals.

Anonymous collapse turns start address, reference and unmapped hints, control block and order into a scan outcome, owning allocation, validation, notification, isolation, copy and install with success and outcome tracing.

PMD installer maps a folio at an address in a VMA, creating upper levels when no PMD pointer is given then delegating to the fault-path installer and holding an extra ref on success; the address-space lock must already be held.

File helpers cover PTE-mapped huge install with full-extent check and locked-folio verification, retraction of empty tables blocking huge file ranges via reverse-map iteration, and preparation of one aligned file range by allocating a locked huge folio, ensuring index capacity and accumulating validated isolated small folios for a later copy.

exports.text: Virtual area removal checks alignment and sleepability, unlinks by address, runs debug checks, tears down tables and frees the area returning its descriptor; unmap tolerates null, forbids interrupt context and warns when absent, while no-MMU unmap always faults.
Protected I/O mapping delegates to a generic helper; generic unmap aligns down to a page and unmaps only inside the I/O remap region; public unmap forwards to it.
Synchronous cross-CPU rendezvous after table removal is weaker than a grace period and suffices only for software walkers relying on interrupt masking.
PMD collapse requires an aligned non-huge entry, atomically takes and clears it and invalidates the huge span; retired table pages are released asynchronously after grace periods.

Public helper replaces small mappings of an already-huge cached folio with one PMD mapping at the aligned address and discards detailed status; advice toggles per-area huge opt-in versus opt-out, excluding opt-out areas from daemon scans.

hazards.text: Removal and unmap may sleep and must not run in interrupt context, warning on misaligned or unknown addresses; walks assert forward progress and warn on truncated huge spans or unexpected leaf states.

Collapse hazards include poison aborting copy, migration entries mimicking mappable PMDs, shared-PMD races on short areas, coexisting huge and small translations without flush, swap faults dropping read protection, distinct retry versus error handling, and swap-in enabling later higher-order collapse.

Scan validations are racy: pins change, entries are replaced by copy, swap or migration across notification, and privileged inserts bypass the address-space lock, so mutation revalidates identity and PMD sameness under table locks. Clearing must update reverse maps and counters, defer flush to the PMD step, decrement table count, run table checks and defer freeing.

invariants.text: Range teardown requires a forward range, walks top chunks, skips empty or bad entries, clears huge entries before descending, accumulates a change mask with arch sync on intersection, reschedules cooperatively at PMD level and warns on truncated huge spans.

Leaf teardown runs under lazy MMU mode, steps by one base page or a larger hugetlb stride, realigns on misalignment, clears through the initial space, marks leaf change and warns on entries neither empty nor present; area release flushes cache, unmaps without flush and conditionally flushes kernel TLB range.

Daemon sleeps default to ten seconds scan and sixty seconds alloc, with read-mostly scan and per-class controls plus collapsed and full-scan counters and an expiry; stores parse base-ten, require nonzero scan pages, cap maxima at fanout minus one, and reset expiry plus wake on sleep stores.

Empty, swapped and shared ceilings abort scans with distinct outcomes; direct collapse is unrestricted, PMD order honors tunables, multi-size forbids shared and swap and scales empty tolerance only at the limit with a one-time warning otherwise, and userfaultfd forces zero empty tolerance.

Empty means missing or zero page; referenced combines folio, leaf and notifier youth. Isolation needs exact expected references plus successful LRU isolation, keeps folios locked and off LRU, queues large ones separately, and daemon scans fail without referenced entries or with swap present but references below half the span. Candidates must be ordinary reclaimable unlocked anon folios with expected refs, allowed node and droppable policy.

Success handling walks every slot, counts empties as anon, drops zero mappings, removes entries and reverse maps under the table lock, then releases swap cache and refs with batching and returns compound folios to reclaim. Copy zeroes empty destinations and poison-aware copies mapped sources, aborting on poison; failure reinstalls the table under PMD lock while pages stay locked before releasing them.

Alloc sleep waits interruptibly and freezably for a tunable interval in daemon mode; strength is full reclaim when a defrag bit is set else light, always full for direct. Charged alloc records stats then charges the group, freeing and reporting on charge failure. Target is the lowest-numbered most-loaded node with all tied online nodes in the mask; reclaim-locality veto rejects unloaded nodes only when a loaded node lies beyond distance.

Revalidation rejects exiting or disabled owners, missing or short areas, disallowed orders and unexpected non-anon remaps. PMD checks report missing tables for empty, non-present or malformed entries and already-mapped for migration or established huge entries; only present well-formed tables pass, and a still-valid check fails when the slot moved.

Swap-in walks slots under read protection, faults only swapped entries, rejects non-PMD orders, treats retry as lock failure without retry, fails on errors and drains reclaim cache when pages arrive. Anon collapse allocates first, validates under read then write protection, marks start-write, checks PMD identity, notifies exactly the range around a flushed PMD clear, syncs tables, then isolates.

Multi-size scan strides a PMD window over enabled orders, counts present entries from a bitmap plus swapped entries for the PMD candidate, attempts only when occupancy meets order tolerance, and caps the next order by trailing alignment of the new offset.

Userfault write protection blocks every path: armed present or swap entries abort anon scans and protected areas are rejected for install and never retractable. Retractable file areas have no anon private state, no userfault or per-entry protection and no guard marker, with the guard check ordered against the table lock.

File collapse differs shmem holes and stale entries from other files where misses trigger readahead and locked fetch; dirty or writeback aborts non-shmem with a one-time flush only when not open for write. Joining folios must be locked, current, small, attached, isolated, buffer-free and unmapped with only cache plus isolation plus local refs. Entry identity is checked before notification and revalidated under lock before batched clear.
Collapse reports disabled when the owner exits or transparent huge pages are fully disabled; this unit prefixes diagnostics with its module name.

locks.text: Vmap lookup starts at the address-derived node and cycles all nodes, holding each node busy spinlock only across find plus unlink.

Slot exit and collection serialize lookup, unlink, cache return and ref drop under a dedicated spinlock, with the active cursor serialized by write-mode address-space locking; daemon control uses a dedicated mutex and mostly read-only thread and tunables after setup.

Collapse orders read protection, then write protection, start-write marking, area write lock, notifier bracketing around PMD lock with flush, then table lock for isolation and copy; scan progress runs under read lock plus table spinlock, both dropped before the actual collapse with a flag recording the drop. PTE lock nests inside PMD lock only when reinstalling smaller-order tables needing a live hierarchy.

Table mutation nests address-space lock, inverse-map read lock and folio lock outside PMD lock with table spinlock innermost and nested acquisition when they differ, bracketed by range notification; private areas with armed userfault take PMD lock earlier against atomic-insert races. PMD lock covers flush and restore while pages stay locked; aborts with cleared entries still flush.

File preparation holds the index-tree lock with interrupts disabled, drops it around blocking acquisition or reclaim and revalidates after relocking, keeps each folio locked to exclude truncation, and unmaps with batched requests plus final sync before copying.

state_machines.text: Isolation walks one leaf per base page counting empty-or-zero and shared entries against maxima, aborting distinctly for over-limit, non-present, userfaultfd, abnormal or device pages, lazyfree policy, existing large mappings and lock contention; outcomes span success, missing tables, huge states, quota, page and area state, alloc and charge, truncation and copy or writeback faults.

Multi-size candidates advance past the stride on success or already-huge, retry the same offset at a smaller enabled order on alloc, ref, tolerance, page or entry setbacks, and stop on already-mapped PMD or other outcomes; final status prefers any success over alloc failure over the last setback.

After isolation and copy, the new folio is marked current before publication with the PMD slot required empty: PMD order deposits the old table and installs a PMD mapping with early write-unprotect, smaller orders repopulate the table and install batched write-unprotected PTE mappings while holding protection; success leads to install or continued accumulation with matching unwind of locks, notifications and refs.

structs.text: Collapse control carries daemon-versus-direct origin, per-node loads, allocation mask, presence bitmap over table fanout, progress and range state; occupancy steers allocation toward the most represented node. Swap-in fault descriptors carry owning area, address, offset from address, retry-allowed flags and PMD slot.

Daemon cursor holds candidate address-space list, current slot and current address with an initially empty list; slots hash by address-space pointer with pointer-equality selection and removal detaches from hash and list.

PMD install uses a fault descriptor with target area, address and PMD location plus cleared flags; clear paths use a notification descriptor with address space, aligned start and end and a clear operation bracketing invalidation.

Geometry uses PMD order with count as one shifted by order, span as page size times count, plus PMD mask, PMD size and base shift; limits cap tolerated entries at fanout minus one with ten-bit slot hash and minimum multi-size order two; policy uses droppable, shared, forced-collapse, PMD-order, guard-bit, exit, swap-backed and folio-state flags, with defrag selected by a global huge-page flag bit.
